correctness.rationale: For finite n>=3, the original shrinking random beta maximal-entropy measure has a finite first-return graph with two excursion paths per length k=2..n and Parry return probability lambda^-k. The ordinary-time digit law is the length-biased stationary suspension of iid blocks b(1-b)^(k-1), each probability q_k/2=lambda^-k. Complement and stationarity identities force reversal symmetry for lengths <=4; rational row elimination gives one-dimensional length-five antisymmetric space with exactly eight nonzero unordered reversal pairs, all of magnitude |Delta|. Direct prefix conditioning yields Delta=(q2-q2²-q3)/(8mu)=-lambda^{-(n+3)}/(2mu)<0; hence TV5=8|Delta|. The characteristic renewal identity implies lambda_n↗2 with n(2-lambda_n)→0 and mu_n→3, giving 2^n TV5→1/6. Independently rebuilt rational length-biased finite-state transition chain for four distinct distributions n=3..6, exactly verified all <=4 reversals, eight five-symbol discrepancies and coefficient. The finite checks do not prove the all-n exponential limit, which is analytic.

originality.rationale: Jiang–Dajani 2016 introduce exactly the shrinking random beta graph and its original-system Parry maximal-entropy structure, not the reversal asymmetry of the ordinary-time binary branch digit process. Arola-Fernández–Lacasa prove general stationary binary symbols cannot witness irreversibility for m<4, while here the extra complement symmetry extends that universal threshold to 4 and the finite beta family first exhibits it at m=5 with an exact shrinking coefficient.

value.rationale: Short-word time-arrow detection is a natural observable in symbolic dynamics and nonequilibrium statistics. Establishing its exact shortest detecting length and complete first discrepancy profile, together with a sharp exponential collapse along a prescribed beta family, gives a motivated and usable invariant rather than a formal reparameterization of the old return graph.
